headline: Barely there and cross — not worth the sand in your wax today.
today: Under waist-high at 1.5ft, short-period SSE, and the wind sits cross most of the day. Prime angle on paper but there's just no size behind it. If anything, the WNW cross-off at dawn is your only clean look — otherwise skip it.

daysToWatch.note: Swell nudges to 3ft but S onshore 15-17mph wrecks it. Blown out, pass.
N offshore 13-14mph over a chest-high prime-angle SSE swell. Dawn to mid-morning is clean and worth a session on the log before the afternoon ENE cross.
